name: Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
ability:
2 Level 8 monsters
You can only Special Summon "Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star(s)" once per turn. You can also Xyz Summon this card by using an "Orcust" Link Monster you control as material. If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead. If this card is Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Send 1 card your opponent controls to the GY.
● Attach 1 of your banished Machine monsters to this card as material.

name: Sky Striker Ace - Kaina

1 non-EARTH "Sky Striker Ace" monster

Each time you activate a "Sky Striker" Spell Card, or its effect, gain 100 LP immediately after the card or effect resolves. You can only Special Summon "Sky Striker Ace - Kaina(s)" once per turn.

name: Subterror Nemesis Archer

You can only use each effect of "Subterror Nemesis Archer" once per turn.

name: Orcust Knightmare

You can only use this effect of "Orcust Knightmare" once per turn.

name: Aloof Lupine

You can only use each effect of "Aloof Lupine" once per turn.

name: Salamangreat Violet Chimera
ability:
1 "Salamangreat" monster + 1 Link Monster

If this card that was Fusion Summoned using "Salamangreat Violet Chimera" as material battles a monster, that monster's ATK becomes 0 during damage calculation only.

ability:
